verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent connectivity. The probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, and the only integration documented is Gusto data sync, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
